title: Word Statistics
description:
```
Paste some text, then end the input (Ctrl+D in Xenon's terminal):
...
Words: 1,204   Unique: 431   Lines: 88
Top 10: the(71) and(40) to(33) of(31) a(28) ...
Longest word: incomprehensible
Average word length: 4.3
```
hints: To sort by count, copy the map into `std::vector<std::pair<std::string, int>>`. `std::ranges::partial_sort(v, v.begin() + 10, [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.second > b.second; });` puts only the first ten in order (check the vector has at least ten first).
Removing punctuation from the ends: while the word is not empty and `std::ispunct(static_cast<unsigned char>(word.back()))`, `pop_back()`; do the same at the front with `erase(0, 1)`.
requirements: Read the text from standard input line by line (or from a file named on the command line)
Lower-case every word and strip punctuation from its ends
The top 10 by count, using a vector of pairs and `std::ranges::partial_sort`
stretch: Leave out common words (the, and, a...) with a `std::unordered_set`, and count word pairs too.
